components.css: :host{--paper:#f4f3ef;--ink:#111111;--muted:#64635e;--rule:#8a8984;--line:#d9d8d2;--raise:#ebeae4;--accent:#ff3d00;--on-accent:#111111;--mono:'JetBrains Mono Variable',ui-monospace,monospace;--display:'Unbounded Variable','JetBrains Mono Variable',sans-serif;--ease-out:cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1);}.ds-keys{display:flex;gap:6px;}.ds-key{width:44px;height:44px;padding:4px 5px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;border:0;border-radius:5px;background:var(--c,var(--raise));box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgb(17 17 17 / .14);color:rgb(17 17 17 / .78);font:400 10px/1.1 var(--mono);cursor:crosshair;transition:transform 90ms var(--ease-out);}.ds-key.dark{color:rgb(255 255 255 / .86);}.ds-key[aria-selected='true']{outline:2px solid var(--ink);outline-offset:2px;color:var(--ink);}.ds-key:active{transform:translateY(2px) scale(.97);}.ds-key:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--accent);outline-offset:2px;}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "The Live Specimen"**

keyglow presents the keyboard the way a foundry presents a variable typeface: the 80HE is the giant glyph, the axis sliders remap it, and a monospace readout prints every number. The ground is warm paper, structure is drawn in one-pixel ink rules, and colour belongs to the keys. The chrome stays achromatic so a preset reads truthfully against it. One foundry orange marks whatever is live: the active axis, the primary action, the current stop.

The density is that of an instrument, not a marketing page. Everything is set in JetBrains Mono at 10 to 13px with tabular figures, in three columns (preset index, stage, tools) separated by full-height ink rules. Unbounded appears exactly twice: the wordmark and the single display readout that names the active axis value. Surfaces are flat. Selection and focus are outlines, not glows; active states invert to ink.

Two themes share one structure. **Paper** is the default. **Ink** swaps ground and ink for dim rooms and warms the accent slightly so it holds contrast on near-black. Both themes are switched through `data-theme` on the root and every component reads only the role variables, never a theme-specific value.
keyCharacteristics: Warm paper ground, ink one-pixel rules, achromatic chrome; the keys carry all the colour.
One accent for "live": active axis, primary action, current stop, focus ring, caret.
Monospace everywhere with tabular figures; Unbounded only for wordmark and display readout.
Flat; active state is ink inversion, selection is an outline.
Two themes, Paper and Ink, from the same role variables.

rules.name: The Keys Own the Colour Rule
rules.body: Chrome is achromatic. Hue enters the UI only as data: key caps, preset colour strips, swatches, the colour field and hue strip.

rules.name: The One Live Thing Rule
rules.body: Foundry Orange marks what is live or primary right now. If two things on a screen are orange, both must be live (for example the active axis and the Connect action); it is never decoration.

rules.name: The Ink and Line Rule
rules.body: Ink rules (1px) divide regions: status bar, index, stage, tools. Line rules (1px) divide items inside a region. No third divider weight.

rules.name: The Two Unbounded Rule
rules.body: Unbounded is used for the wordmark and the single display readout. Every other string, including headings and large values, is JetBrains Mono.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: All figures are tabular; numeric formats are padded where they scrub (hue as `±000°`, speed as `0.00×`).

rules.name: The Specimen Scale Rule
rules.body: The keyboard spans the full stage width at its true 17.25:6.25 aspect; nothing sits beside it.

rules.name: The Outline, Not Glow Rule
rules.body: Focus is a 2px accent outline offset 2px. Key selection is a 2px ink outline offset 2px. Neither uses blur.

dos: **Do** read every colour through the role variables (`--paper`, `--ink`, `--muted`, `--rule`, `--line`, `--raise`, `--accent`, `--on-accent`) so Paper and Ink both work without per-theme overrides.
**Do** draw region boundaries with 1px ink rules and in-region dividers with 1px line rules.
**Do** show an active or pressed state by inverting to ink with paper text.
**Do** keep Foundry Orange for what is live or primary: the active axis, the primary action, the current stop, focus.
**Do** set every number in JetBrains Mono with tabular figures, and print slider ends.
**Do** keep controls at 2px radius and key caps at 5px.
donts: **Don't** use Unbounded for anything beyond the wordmark and the single display readout.
**Don't** add elevation shadows or glows; hairline 1px rings on caps and thumbs are the only box-shadows.
**Don't** mark the active preset row with a coloured side stripe; it is ink inversion plus an accent code.
**Don't** put hue into the chrome; colour in the UI is data (keys, strips, swatches, the colour field).
**Don't** use Rule Grey for readable text; it is for disabled values and resting icons.
